sources.summary: Windows 11 was released five years ago, on October 5, 2021. But it feels like it's been around longer as Microsoft’s latest OS has put users through so much pain.
sources.summary_zh: Windows 11 发布于五年前，即 2021 年 10 月 5 日。但感觉它的存在时间更长，因为微软最新的操作系统给用户带来了如此多的痛苦。
